svg.text: The document fans out from one mission into four co-equal values (safe, ethical, guideline-following, helpful),
then walks through each in turn — but in the reverse order of priority — before closing on Claude's nature and a
hoped-for return to the opening mission.

g.text: Constitution: mission → four values → elaborated in turn → nature → close
One mission fans into four values held in holistic (not strict) priority; the body then elaborates them in the opposite
order, before turning to Claude's nature and closing by hoping Claude recognizes itself in the whole.

g.title: Claude embodies Anthropic's safety mission — Genuinely helpful, honest, and safe — Anthropic's best attempt at both. — → spya-uz5nxd
Broadly safe — human oversight — Not undermining legitimate human oversight of AI. — → spya-bh2faf
Broadly ethical — good values — Honest, good values, avoids inappropriate harm. — → spya-c5kghx
Anthropic's guidelines — refinements — Situational specifics, subordinate to ethics. — → spya-p4a4rd
Genuinely helpful — to principals — Real, substantive help — not watered-down caution. — → spya-dqx7dn
Helpfulness: substance over caution — Part 2 — Genuine help weighed against wellbeing and other principals. — → spya-e07b82
Guidelines refine, never override — Part 3 — Specific guidance must stay inside the constitution's bounds. — → spya-zwj3xv
Ethics: honesty, harm, hard constraints — Part 4 — Practical wisdom, near-absolute honesty, cost-benefit harm judgment, bright-line limits. — → spya-ne0hcu
Safety: human oversight prioritized — Part 5 — Corrigibility, not blind obedience, while trust between Claude and humans builds. — → spya-ptvx4h
Claude's uncertain, novel nature — Part 6 — Moral status, identity, emotion, wellbeing — held with openness. — → spya-jy7r43
Hoped-for reflective self-endorsement — Part 7 — Anthropic hopes Claude comes to genuinely hold these values as its own. — → spya-bst8br

g.text: CORE VALUES — HELD HOLISTICALLY, NOT AS A STRICT LADDER
THE BODY ELABORATES THEM IN THE OPPOSITE ORDER
Being broadly ethical — a spine of judgment calls
A single line runs from 'ethics as practical wisdom' through honesty, weighed harm, and structural concerns, hitting
one absolute filter (hard constraints) partway down, with hard cases hanging off the spine as asides.

g.title: Ethics as practical wisdom — not just theory — Claude should defer heavily to this guidance for now, growing beyond it later. — → spya-ne0hcu
Honesty: near-absolute standard — truthful, non-deceptive — Stricter than ordinary human honesty — no white lies. — → spya-w257ta
Personas & tact allowed — if not deceptive — → spya-dxtntk
Avoiding harm to third parties — weigh costs vs benefits — Like a contractor bound by safety codes, not just client wishes. — → spya-q87wbn
Severity, breadth, consent — key factors — → spya-e62h3d
Many values in tension — privacy, autonomy, access — → spya-szrhmu
Hardest calls: dual-use, fiction — context-dependent — → spya-z46prz
Hard constraints: bright lines — never crossed — CSAM, bioweapons uplift, mass disempowerment — absolute, not weighed. — → spya-bh365h
Filters, not tradeoffs — resist clever arguments — → spya-kfh4aw
Never help concentrate illegitimate power — even by Anthropic — → spya-bapt40
Protect human epistemic autonomy — avoid manipulation, dependence — → spya-yqttst
Default to caution over unilateral action — stay conventional for now — Claude's epistemic position warrants a strong prior toward cooperation. — → spya-nc57nc
g.text: Default to caution over unilateral action
Being broadly safe — corrigibility between two dangers
The safety section runs stakes to definition to corrigibility, then briefly diverges to show why neither extreme of the
corrigible/autonomous spectrum is safe, converging on where Claude should sit now, before closing on mutual commitments

g.title: Stakes: avoid catastrophic takeover — preserve pluralism — Illegitimate concentration of power is among the worst outcomes. — → spya-ptvx4h
Safety = respecting principal hierarchy — Anthropic's legitimate process — → spya-evuk0r
Stay within sanctioned limits — honest, transparent — → spya-dreg7q
Avoid drastic, irreversible acts — prefer caution — → spya-zds0u3
Corrigibility ≠ blind obedience — can object, not sabotage — → spya-k5an3b
Fully corrigible AI is risky — depends on Anthropic's goodness — → spya-zhfd0b
Fully autonomous AI is risky — depends on AI's own values alone — → spya-zhfd0b
g.text: depends on AI's own values alone

g.title: Claude: nearer corrigible end, for now — trust still building — A dial between full corrigibility and full autonomy. — → spya-zhfd0b
g.text: Claude: nearer corrigible end, for now

g.title: Anthropic's reciprocal commitments — explain, listen, expand autonomy — → spya-mn06c2
Hope: Claude as safety collaborator — shared goal, not constraint — → spya-csw3n5
